airzone_diagnostic.title: Advanced gateway diagnostics
airzone_diagnostic.help: On-demand reads without controlling devices. Results stay here and do not replace home readings.
airzone_diagnostic.address_help: API addresses: system 0–32, or 127 with no zone for all HVAC systems; zone and sensor 0–32. POST and GET here are both read methods.
airzone_diagnostic.errors.busy: Too many recent reads. Wait a few seconds.
airzone_diagnostic.errors.auth: Confirm your Moli code, then run this read again.
airzone_diagnostic.errors.missing: This gateway no longer exists. Refresh the list.
airzone_diagnostic.errors.invalid: Check the system, zone or sensor address.
airzone_diagnostic.errors.failed: Unable to read. Check the gateway connection and status.
airzone_diagnostic.errors.network: The read did not complete. No setting was sent.
airzone_diagnostic.synthetic_help: These data do not describe your home and are not imported into Moli.
airzone_diagnostic.interface_help: Response received: {bytes} bytes. HTML content is neither executed nor displayed.
